bullets.text: Police are investigating after a male body was found floating in the Narayanapuram lake in Pallikaranai.
Three hundred people received work orders at a free employment camp held in Pallikaranai by the BJP skills wing.
A white-tailed sea eagle has been recorded for the first time in the protected Pallikaranai marshland.
In Sengundram, police recovered forty-three sovereigns of stolen gold buried in the ground after a teacher couple's house was burgled.
Murukkampattu villagers are suffering as an overhead water tank built for sixteen lakh rupees has remained unused for three years.
Motorists faced severe traffic congestion and struggled to commute in Thiruthani.
US President Donald Trump threatened a tremendous tax on American firms building AI data centers abroad, raising concerns for India.
Karnataka's higher education department proposed an AI-based facial recognition attendance system with online updates for parents.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated in Lucknow that artificial intelligence cannot take away the livelihood of skilled workers.
